source: larena-specs docs/architecture/2026-10-29-sites-work-plan.md, stage 10; simai-env docs/architecture/panel-gate.md, gateway stage 2 (1.21.0), answers recorded with 1.25.0
scope: the site's own screen (certificate, backups, nginx log) and the actions that belong to it: a plan is shown, a person confirms it, the gateway starts a job and the panel follows it with job:status and job:log
known_limitations: the panel keeps no audit trail of its own yet: every request is logged by the gateway with its request id, and the screen shows the operation id
a running job is followed by opening the screen again, not by the page refreshing itself
deploys, creating and removing sites (gateway stage 3-4) are not offered
